items.title: Richard Flemmings: AGI Foresight Report UK
items.summary: New Geomob host Denise discusses the recently released AGI Foresight Report with Richard Flemmings, CEO of Map Impact. They explore the significance of the report, its findings, and the reflections from the AGI conference. Key themes include the evolution of geospatial technology, the importance of skills development, and the global relevance of the report's insights. The conversation emphasizes the need for collaboration within the geospatial community and invites listeners to engage with the report's recommendations. Show notes on the Geomob website , where you can also learn more about Geomob events and sign up for our monthly newsletter.
